site: ADP electronic-signing step; shared dynamic-field reader
class: A final declaration exposed an answerable field after planning and was handed off as unknown
symptom: After the signing checkbox was checked, the required Please type your full name field appeared and the run stopped despite the profile containing the applicant's name.
root_cause: Final declaration actions run after ordinary answers. Newly revealed controls were checked for blanks before a fresh plan, and the name matcher recognized full-name labels only without imperative enter/type/provide prefixes.
why_tests_missed: Earlier signature tests kept the name input visible at planning time and used direct Full Name labels. They did not introduce a required name input in response to checking a declaration.
fix: Reread newly exposed fields when supported profile or authorized declaration answers exist, under the existing page/shape limits. Resolve imperative full-name prompts while retaining exclusions for other people's names. Scope ADP review-step lookup to navigation list items so duplicate page headings do not suppress evidence collection.
prevention: Test conditional fields revealed by final declarations and resolve supported profile facts before handoff. Distinguish navigation controls from headings with the same text.
